_comment: Signal bars mapping for SKU refa (ch.07 S14). dBm->bars thresholds MEASURED against this modem's reported values, never copied from stock screenshots. Airplane/shutdown override bars (MODEM_DEAD clears indicators <=3s). ASCII only.
rules: airplane/shutdown states override bars (never stale 4-bars with dead modem)
roaming R badge mirrors MM home-only flag
data-activity arrows reflect actual bearer traffic (1s window), never animation
frozen arrows + '...' badge during DATA_STALL SUSPECT (data-stall-policy.conf T+0)
audit: 50-state script (register/deregister/airplane/SIM-pull/data-toggle): every indicator matches mmcli within 3s, 0 mismatch to pass
